title: Effectiveness of naturally derived bovine hydroxyapatite (CeraboneTM) combined with platelet-rich fibrin matrix in socket preservation: A randomized controlled clinical trial
authors: Kollati P, Koneru S, Dwarakanath CD, Gottumukkala SN. Journal of In dian Society of Periodontology 2018. DOI: 10.4103/jisp.jisp_400_18.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The authors concluded that the described socket preservation procedure is a reliable method that minimizes alveolar bone loss” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
